_notes: NXP PCT2075, LM75-compatible temperature sensor, 0.125 C, at any of 27 addresses (A0-A2 tri-state): 0x28-0x2F, 0x35-0x37 (Adafruit default 0x37), 0x48-0x4F, 0x70-0x77. No ID register, so detection checks the registers' fixed bits (read-only): temperature low 5 bits 0 (11-bit, left-justified), configuration bits 7-5 0, Thyst and Tos low 7 bits 0 (9-bit), Tidle bits 7-5 0, and pointer 0x07 (no register) reads 0xFFFF - a part whose low registers read 0 (e.g. a BME280, which matched all the bit patterns) or a TMP117 (offset register 0x0000) fails that. Being a pattern rather than an ID, it is tried after the records with an ID at the same address (identPriority -1) - a TMP117 or an idle CAP1188 can pass it - except records with no detection (GravityO2 at 0x70-0x73), which claim the address first. Init: configuration 0 (normal mode, in case it was left shut down). Poll: temperature register; signed 16-bit / 256 (the low 5 bits are 0).
